mapper.select: SELECT v.target_type AS targetType, v.target_id AS targetId, v.name, v.category, v.is_sold_out AS isSoldOut, v.image_url AS imageUrl, CASE v.target_type WHEN 'MENU' THEN 1 WHEN 'INGREDIENT' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mi.menu_id) FROM menu_ing mi JOIN menu m ON m.id = mi.menu_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE mi.ing_id = v.target_id ) WHEN 'OPTION_ITEM' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mop.menu_id) FROM opt_policy_item opi JOIN menu_opt_policy mop ON mop.policy_id = opi.policy_id JOIN menu m ON m.id = mop.menu_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE opi.opt_item_id = v.target_id ) ELSE 0 END AS affectedMenuCount FROM vw_soldout_catalog v ORDER BY v.name
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ing SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId}
UPDATE opt_item SET sold_out = #{isSoldOut} WHERE id = #{targetId}
